يكتنف (form VIII)
# يَكْتَنِفُ (yaktanifu) /jak.ta.ni.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# يُكْتَنَفُ (yuktanafu) /juk.ta.na.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# يَكْتَنِفَ (yaktanifa) /jak.ta.ni.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# يُك
